search_azure_azure_ai: search the Azure AI Search index using api_key, endpoint, index_name, query string, and result count
create_azure_search_client: create an AzureKeyCredential and SearchClient instance for Azure AI Search authentication
extract_search_results_fields: extract link, title, and snippet from Azure AI Search result documents with flexible field name mapping
filter_search_results_by_domain: filter Azure AI Search results by a list of allowed domains using get_filtered_results
truncate_long_search_snippets: truncate search result snippets longer than 500 characters to 500 characters with ellipsis
